1#_: (Siman 102, Taz s.k. 10) "This is because his Mishnah overpowered him." All the Acharonim preceded him in this, as Shach wrote in s.k. 10; and what he wrote "but in the substance of the law he wrote well according to Orach Chayim," etc. — it is not so, as Siftei Kohen s.k. 9 wrote — for Orach Chayim also holds thus. And what he wrote "it is not called something that has a permitted aspect" — see Shach and Siftei Kohen at length there; and what Taz wrote that an unsalted piece is also something that has a permitted aspect is not as he wrote in s.k. 9 — end of his words.
